div.head: VI Atr 35
div.ab: K. ⁊ gif hwa of fyrde butan leafe gewende, þe cyning [sylf on] sy, plihte his are.
⁊ gif hwa of fyrde butan leafe gewende þe cyning sylf on sy, plihte his are.
And gif hwa of fyrde butan leafe gewende þe cyning sylf on sy, plihte his are.
Und wenn einer ohne Erlaubniss von der Landwehr, bei der der König selbst ist, fortgeht, bringe er seiner Besitzerstellung Gefahr der Verwirkung.
And if anyone leaves the army without permission when the king himself is with it, let him put his whole property at risk of forfeiture.
And if anyone deserts an army which is under the personal command of the king, it shall be at the risk of losing his property.
And if anyone deserts an army led by the king himself, he shall risk forfeiture of his property.

note.label: squares with
note.quote: The G2 option of buying off death for desertion, V 28, squares with VI Atr 35, loss of property alone

div.note: Only in K. Liebermann compares V Atr 28.

note.seg: Bewusst weicht dies und 36³ ab von V 28³; s. d.—Zu L: procinctus für Heereszug setzt auch Urk. a. 1012 Ke 1307
This and 36³ deliberately depart from V 28³; see there.—On L: a charter of 1012, Ke 1307, also uses procinctus for a military expedition
The omission of any reference to the death penalty is noticeable.
